newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Fibre files for 2.6 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Fibre files for 2.6 mln shares.

text.p: Advanced Fibre Communications Inc said Friday it filed a registation with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.6 million common shares.

Of the total, 2.08 million common will be sold in the United States and Canada and 520,000 common will be offered for sale outside those two countries, the filing said. After the offer, outstanding shares will total 33,157,535 common.
Of the 2.08 million common shares being offered, 1.92 million are being sold by selling stockholders including Telllabs Inc with 735,492 and St. Paul Venture Capital with 614,874 common.
The balance of 160,000 common will be sold by the company.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option to purchase up to 390,000 common shares. The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co, Cowen & Co and Hambrecht & Quist.
Advanced Fibre develops, manufactures, markets and supports universial modular carrier -- a cost-effective multifeature digital loop carrier system for small line-sized markets.
